subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: Should a QQ Bot C2C sender be authorized to resolve plugin approvals merely because the approval prompt was delivered in that private conversation?
rationale: Current documentation and merged hardening require explicit non-wildcard authorization, while the paired pull request would make every admitted direct-message sender an approver; repository evidence cannot determine the intended trust boundary without maintainer policy.

options.title: Preserve Explicit Authorization
options.body: Keep the current allowlist or execApprovals approver requirement and fix prompt targeting, denial messaging, and timeout UX.

options.title: Verified Owner Exception
options.body: Permit implicit C2C approval only when the callback actor matches a separately resolved and tested owner identity.

options.title: Trust Every C2C Sender
options.body: Accept approval clicks from any sender admitted to a direct conversation, including open or wildcard DM configurations.

recommendation.title: Preserve Explicit Authorization
recommendation.body: Keep the current allowlist or execApprovals approver requirement and fix prompt targeting, denial messaging, and timeout UX.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current security boundary appears to originate in their merged approval-gating work.
